$comment: Papers for the social-cards template only. Documents keep the single-accent print palette in tokens.json; these values are allowed in social-cards*.html and demo-social-cards*.html and nowhere else. Each paper is one background, one text color, one accent, one muted color and one footer rule (text mixed 16% into the background). Contrast on its background: text >= 8.8:1, accent >= 6:1, muted >= 4.3:1 (every muted use is 28px or larger). The template mirrors these as --social-<paper>-<role>; --check fails on drift.
